title: Mount Point / Free-Space Validation
description: Verifies expected mount points are present, writable, and have at least a minimum amount of free space, using gathered facts (ansible_facts.mounts) rather than shelling out to df -- fails the play on any target host with a problem.

variables.name: MIN_FREE_PERCENT
variables.prompt: Minimum free space required, as a percent (0 to skip the free-space check)

toggles.name: CHECK_WRITABLE
toggles.prompt: Also verify each mount is writable
